title: Thank the Body
description: Notice the body after the effort, and thank it for what it did today.

steps.text: Take a moment to notice the body after the effort. The heat. The heartbeat. The tiredness.
This body carried you through the training today. It did what you asked of it.
Silently, thank it. The legs that held you. The lungs that kept breathing. The heart that kept the pace.
Notice one thing that felt good today. Stay with it for a few breaths.
Rest here. There is nothing more to do.
